source: docs/dataset-spec.md §2, EGY negative check (MSA-isms) and MSA rules
notes: msa_isms: whole-word, clitic-aware after folding (proclitics و/ف/ب/ل/ك, only و on one- and two-letter words; no enclitics, so «إلينا» and «أهلا» pass).
exact_only: MSA-isms matched without proclitics; add a word here if a proclitic form collides with Egyptian (e.g. «ولدي»).
msa_forbidden: the spec's «بل/سوف/لذا» for the MSA column; «إنّ» is handled apart: with shadda it is an error, bare «إن» a warning (it may be the conditional).
future_with_hamza: verb-first «هـ» written with hamza («هأحجز»), an error in MSA.
